content_sections.heading: How-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for District Panchayat Sarangarh-Bilaigarh PRP (Project Resource Person) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the District Panchayat Sarangarh-Bilaigarh under the NRLM scheme for hiring project resource personnel.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post is PRP (Project Resource Person) under District Panchayat Sarangarh-Bilaigarh recruitment for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Resource Person (PRP) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in, meaning eligible candidates can directly attend the interview on the designated date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 01 October 2026. Candidates must reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 12th pass with trained PRP certification. Having prior work experience as a PRP will give candidates extra preference.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as per the guidelines laid out in the official government notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for participating in this walk-in interview recruitment process.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original educational and identity certificates along with self-attested photocopies, photographs, and completed application forms.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website for further updates?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the district administration at Sarangarh-bilaigarh.cg.gov.in to check for further recruitment announcements and updates.
